description: Implementation of the ProductImageService handling product image operations such as adding, retrieving, and removing product images in an e-commerce system. The class integrates with data access and file management components.

classes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for product image management, extending base entity service and implementing specific image handling methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductImage entity by its ID.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Add multiple product images to a product, converting image streams to content files.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Add a single product image, saving image content and updating database records.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persist a new ProductImage or update an existing one, handling descriptions.

methods.name: addProductImageDescription
methods.description: Associate a description with a product image.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieve a product image content, optionally resized based on specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieve a product image content based on store code, product code, filename, and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Get all images associated with a product.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Remove a product image and delete associated content.
